remarks: Immaculate + Sun-filled in the heart of vibrant & desirable Noroton, this enchanting home offers walking distance to the metro north train as well as popular neighborhood restaurants + shops, grocery and more! Flexible & updated, you'll find 3-4 bedrooms (including a 1st floor bedroom option), 2-full baths, open kitchen/dining/family room, formal living room with fireplace, 2-car garage, central air, large & level fenced back lawn with patio and front porch for outdoor relaxation and enjoyment. This property is pet friendly. Available in July, come see, PET CAUTION. VIEWING BY APPT. ONLY.
